reason: The hypothesis directly combines the cryo-rolling and annealing processing route from P41/P37 with the known precipitation of Al-rich L12 from P2/P6/P7 and the corrosion resistance findings from P3/P5/P28, but it does not integrate these into a single, new proposal; it merely lists them together. The core idea of using cryo-rolling and annealing to create a hierarchical microstructure for improved strength-ductility is already demonstrated in P41 and P37, and the predicted outcomes are restatements of those results. The addition of corrosion resistance is a minor extension without a new mechanistic link, and the falsification test is a generic comparative experiment.

simultaneous enhancement of strength and ductility

semi-coherent phase boundaries contributing to strength
